sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent four-pose pixel sprite atlas for an existing 2D Sun Wukong game.
Reference image: the existing Wukong atlas defines EXACT identity, proportions, monkey muzzle, russet fur, gold circlet with two red feather tips, dark teal travelling armour with tarnished gold scales, vermilion scarf and cloth, worn boots. Preserve them. Generate new poses, not a new character.
Layout: TWO columns by TWO rows, four complete full body sprites, generous alpha gutters, identical scale and shared foot baseline in each cell, every pose faces RIGHT. Square canvas. No scenery, ground, shadows, text, border, grid or checkerboard. Real transparent background.
Important weapon constraint: each pose holds only a SHORT DARK IRON GRIP between the hands. Do NOT draw a full long staff, pole, gold tip, energy trail or extended weapon: the game will attach its telescoping rod to the forward hand dynamically.
Reading order:
1 concentrated charge: planted feet, knees flexed, torso turns back slightly, both hands drawing the short horizontal iron grip toward waist, scarf tight behind.
2 committed horizontal thrust: athletic low forward lunge, front hand extended right at chest/waist height, rear hand stabilizes the short grip, force readable in shoulder and rear heel. The grip ends at the forward palm, no projecting weapon.
3 recovery: weight retreats onto rear leg, elbows fold while pulling the short grip back, cloth settles, clearly different silhouette from charge.
4 pole-vault ascent: knees tuck, torso lifts, both hands press the short grip diagonally down-right, gaze forward, scarf arcs down-left. Again no pole beyond the forward hand.
Style: crisp authored pixel clusters, charcoal contour, grouped gold highlights, warm monkey face readable at 75px body height, same polished mineral-pigment material detail as reference. Not a chibi mascot, no smooth painted blur. Keep all four heads, costumes and limb sizes consistent.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production four-pose pixel animation atlas for the SAME Nezha as the reference sprite strip.
Preserve exact identity, youthful face, twin hair buns and red hair ties, red/vermillion silk ribbons, dark teal trousers and waist, tarnished-gold armour and bracers, slim athletic proportions. Add the traditional TWO small bronze fire-and-wind wheels, one beneath each foot. Do not redesign the outfit. Hands are OPEN: do not hold a ring, spear, staff or other weapon; the physical thrown ring is rendered separately by the game.
Layout: TWO columns by TWO rows, square transparent atlas. Four complete sprites, same body scale, facing RIGHT, equal cells, generous transparent gutters. Feet / wheel contact anchors consistent. No background, floor, text, labels, grid or cast shadows.
Reading order:
1 takeoff: knees flexed pressing down on two newly ignited small bronze wheels, hands balance forward, compact flame bursts below feet.
2 hover: upright poised body, one hand extended with OPEN throwing palm, two wheels visibly supporting feet, short controlled orange flames; silhouette clear.
3 forward flight: lean into rightward movement, one knee slightly raised, red ribbons stream LEFT, feet stay on paired wheels, short separate ember tails to left.
4 braking / descent: lean back slightly, arms balance, knees bend and paired wheels tilt, flames dim to red-orange tips, not a hurt pose.
Pixel art: crisp clustered pixels and dark contours, grouped aged-gold highlights matching existing art, warm orange/ivory wheel flame with darker bronze hubs, red wind silk. Flames stay SHORT and behind feet, never conceal the body or fill the cell. Visible handcrafted material detail, no smooth airbrushed glow, no chibi block head. Consistent face, costume, body and wheel size in all poses. Genuine alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production pixel-art modular ability VFX atlas for a 2D Buddhist-ruins action platformer. Square canvas, FOUR columns TWO rows, eight separate equal cells with wide clear gutters, real alpha background. No text, labels, borders, scenery, cast shadows or characters.
Style: carved ancient bronze, dark iron, vermilion wind, orange/ivory fire; crisp authored pixel clusters, grouped highlights, restrained effects matching the detailed reference armour. No blur, bloom or screen-filling smoke.
Reading order:
ROW1: 1 A single horizontal cylindrical dark-iron rod shaft module, straight and side-on, subtle metallic grey ridges, both ends cut straight, no caps, approximately 75 percent cell width and 8 percent cell height. 2 A separate right-pointing gold staff end-cap, cylindrical with small carved cloud bands and rounded gold strike tip, horizontal side-on, 45 percent cell width and 12 percent height, no attached long shaft. 3 A warm ivory/gold sharp star spark of a precise staff-tip hit, compact, a few curved bronze chips, 40 percent cell size. 4 A small red-orange fire-and-wind trail flowing LEFT from a right-side wheel source, tapered scattered embers, short curved warm gust streak, 70 percent width and 20 percent height.
ROW2: 1 locked airborne enemy seal warning: a hollow magenta/purple lotus-shaped ornamental ring viewed face-on, DARK translucent center empty, delicate four pointed petals, clear hollow threat silhouette, no solid rectangular field. 2 SAME seal exploding: open magenta crystal lotus petals, sparse bright inner arcs and a dark hollow center, exact same centered size, no opaque flash blob. 3 a bronze shield brace emblem: two layered bronze shield plates with magenta strain/crack accents, small upward horn silhouette, no full enemy. 4 a concentrated gold/ivory charge halo made of a few sparse tapered rings and tiny motes, hollow transparent center, no letters or icon.
Keep every asset inside its cell. Rod modules and end-cap must be separate, so the game can repeat the iron shaft without stretching the gold bands. These are in-world sprites, not UI skill buttons.

process: tools/prepare-signature-art.py; common body scale and foot/wheel anchor; source alpha preserved
